disposal.rule: std::string SSO: temp pointer equal to the temp's own +0x10 slot address frees nothing; otherwise delete(pointer, capacity + 1) with capacity from +0x10

gate.rule: null pointer returns at once with no produce, emit or disposal; non-null proceeds

landing_pad.cleanup: disposes the temp string (rbp holds the temp slot) and resumes unwinding with rbx; recorded, not modelled as a normal return
landing_pad.entry: 0x5d520b5 inside the routine FDE, saves the incoming value in rbx and jumps to the cleanup block

not_claimed: what the virtual produce callee computes
what the +0x548 object or the +0x360 sink denote
how the emit callee combines its arguments internally
caller semantics beyond the site and FDE range
behaviour on dangling pointers or a null object pointer (the routine reads +0x548 unconditionally, so the model raises on a null object)

arguments: temp string slot at rsp as hidden string-result slot
produce.callee: virtual method at vtable slot 0xe8 of the +0x548 object
produce.opaque: what string the callee produces is not pinned

trailing_bytes: bytes after the FDE range, 0x5d520c1..0x5d520d0, are int3 padding, not a landing-pad block
